requirements.source_quote: 应在合同生效后30日内交付，并提交实施进度表。
requirements.subject: Original delivery-deadline component / 原交付期限成分
requirements.condition: After the contract becomes effective / 合同生效后
requirements.notes: Only the delivery-deadline component is superseded by example-addendum body:1. The schedule duty is preserved as example-schedule. / 仅交付期限成分被 example-addendum body:1 替代，进度表义务保留为 example-schedule。

requirements.source_quote: 交付期限修改为合同生效后45日内，其余要求不变。
requirements.subject: Amended delivery-deadline component / 修改后的交付期限成分
requirements.condition: After the contract becomes effective / 合同生效后
requirements.notes: Illustration assumes applicable publication/version authority is established. It modifies the deadline in example-tender body:1 only; other duties remain. / 演示假设适用发布/版本权威已确认，仅修改 example-tender body:1 的交付期限，其他义务不变。

requirements.subject: Surviving implementation schedule duty / 继续有效的实施进度表义务
requirements.proof_requirement: Implementation schedule; submission stage and timing require clarification / 实施进度表；提交阶段及时点待澄清
requirements.notes: Original duty in example-tender body:1; example-addendum body:1 explicitly preserves the remaining requirements. The source does not establish submission with the bid or rejection consequences; applicability at the bid-review stage remains pending. / 原义务位于 example-tender body:1；example-addendum body:1 明确保留其余要求，原文未明确须随投标提交或否决后果；在投标审查阶段的适用性待确认。

requirements.source_quote: 服务能力可由服务证书或同类合同证明。
requirements.subject: Alternative service-capability proof / 服务能力证明备选
requirements.proof_requirement: Service certificate OR similar contract; either alternative satisfies this duty / 服务证书或同类合同，任一备选满足该义务
requirements.notes: One OR group; do not create two mandatory requirements. No rejection consequence is assumed. / 保留一个 OR 组，不建立两项并列强制义务，不假定否决后果。
